sta_landlady.text: This was the stationmaster's lodge, back when St Andrews had a station by the course. Now it's the nineteenth hole for the seventeenth.
Quiz? Scottish questions. The golfers always get the golf ones and nothing else.

sta_golfer_pub.text: I was in the Road Hole bunker for three shots. Three. I've come in here to think about my choices.
Mind, my grandad played with a gutty ball and a cleek. If he could get round, so can I. Eventually.
